description: Defines classes and enums related to warning reporting categories, including handling of plugin state changes and long-running message warnings.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin with analysis, serialization, and string conversion functionalities.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a message that took too long to process, with analysis, serialization, and string conversion functionalities.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes different message types or plugin states to populate class members.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes class data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into class members.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts class data into a human-readable string format.
